text:
Some altimeters use the change in air pressure to measure height.
If the pressure is 100kPa at sea level on a particular day, what will the pressure be at the top of
an 830m hill?
(Take the density of air to be constant at 1.3kg/m3.)
A
1.1kPa
B
11kPa
C
89kPa
D
110kPa
subject: Physics
